ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels on distal lobe surfaces to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels in the central medial region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels form contiguous masses across both lateral lobes. A low-intensity dark region is centrally localized, extending from the base and tapering outwards with irregular, feathered boundaries into the white fields. Distal tips show dark pigmentation on the very edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; vertex depth is clearly defined relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration pattern (approx. 15 distinct peaks). Left lobe trailing edge displays lower frequency, more rounded topographic variations with a smoother profile near the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in acute-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-intensity (dark) circular pixel clusters observed on the high-intensity white background of the right lobe; sparse similar clusters on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct low-intensity linear feature oriented vertically on the mid-right lobe, approximately 40 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular serrations and minor notches along the trailing edge, particularly concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Central black pigmentation forms a distinctive symmetrical 'bat-wing' geometric shape across the medial fluke span.
